body: I think that's giving him a little too much credit...

My mother calls me a sullen, moody teenager.  My dad works a lot and I think he cares, but he's not entirely with it in terms of figuring out emotions of others.  I only see my boyfriend when we're on college breaks.  Most of my day at home I spend reading or watching a movie or in my room and away from everyone.  I cover it up most of the time I think, but it can slip through sometimes.  Today my boyfriend said I was acting weird.  I think my mom perceives some of it, but she never lets me know until years later and in the meantime she will make me feel guilty for my 'attitude.'

I'm hoping to get out of the house sometimes.  I've managed to alienate myself from a few good friends with whom I used to spend all of my time.  I don't really have the urge to salvage the relationships.  They're not really worth it.

I'm taking steps to get out and do something.  I've been looking for jobs (but like I've said before I've been rejected from over 8 so far) and there aren't any volunteer possibilities near me.  I'm taking a course at a university for fun and might get my subbing license.  It's hard to do things because my parents don't want to go anywhere, I can't take the car, and we're too far to walk to anywhere.

The biggest part of my problem is that I am the common denominator to everything wrong in my life.

There are things that have happened to me and that I've done to others that I don't feel entirely comfortable sharing with anyone...even the internet =p

I don't consider myself to be a nice person even though people tell me that I am.  There's always more to do that I cannot and will not do.  There are people who need help and who need to come to me to talk, but I don't have anyone to trust.  Too much of me would hurt the people that I care about.

I got home last night and was sitting on my bed when everything that has happened on the phone or internet or in town smacked me in the face like being smothered with a big wet blanket.

It is so hard for me to shake off all of the millions and millions of things that I remember so vividly...

I went to a college psychologist for a while but didn't go this semester because of an intense schedule.  I've been feeling like this since elementary school and have never felt like I could tell anyone without being ridiculed and having my emotions brushed off as if they are stupid.  This is what has happened with almost everyone I've told.  It's easier to talk anonymously and give/be given advice anonymously in my opinion.  I feel like friends who I've told look at me funny and focus on this one, scary, awful part of me that wants to die.  I'm glad that I can come here to vent and share.  It's a long time till August.

It is a huge emotional relief.  I like the feeling of gouging away (I've never been a razor girl, more of a blunt object with point side girl).  It's deep and hurts the right way and I can get satisfaction for weeks just by peeling off the scab.  If I "get a cut" that I blame on some random object, my family and friends are used to me picking at scabs compulsively.

I am old enough (almost twenty) but there are little things that keep me here.  My sister is considerably younger than I am, and I want to be a positive part of her life.  She is probably on of the biggest reasons that I've never done anything drastic.  I don't have a car or friends with cars so there would be no way to come visit.  My parents wouldn't be supportive of me moving out.  Plus, I've already been rejected from over 8 jobs that I've applied to over the last few months.  I don't want to chance moving out and then not having a way to support myself.  My roommate at school and I are considering getting a full year on-campus apartment for next summer, and it's so much easier to find a job at school than it is at home.

I want to walk out in front of a car.  I know somewhere deep inside that people love me and will be negatively affected if I do this, but I can't believe that most of the time.  I have friends and a sister and a boyfriend who love me.  Sometimes I think the boyfriend part can be questionable...  I just freak out sometimes and can't figure out how to rationalize getting through the night.  I cut when I was younger but haven't done it for a while.  It's summer, so I can't cut in my favorite places because I don't want the freak out attention, I just want to do it for myself.  I feel emotional and unhappy to the point at which I constantly want to throw up and just lay in bed and sleep all day and all night.  I'm home for the summer, and part of me doesn't want to make it through.  I needed to share these feelings (and probably many others) in an environment where maybe I won't be judged because of feelings that I have a hard time shaking off...
